responsibility: This implementation module manages the process exit code for the Logitech compatibility library. It stores the current exit value, synchronizes it with the M2RTS ExitOnHalt runtime hook so HALT-based termination returns the chosen status, allows callers to query the current code, and provides an ExitToOS entry point that terminates by halting.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the ErrorCode pair: it keeps the exitCode variable, calls M2RTS.ExitOnHalt, and makes ExitToOS terminate via HALT, whereas ErrorCode.def is only the interface declaration.
